method: Isolated Chromium SwiftShader software; 480×320 DPR1; 16 alternating paired gl.finish samples after warm-up per version/case, same absolute camera/time/weather/profile/light uniforms and frozen ordinary life. CPU support/clearance/movement batches measured separately, not summed into GPU time. Eight views × three profiles. Allocations are logical instrumented WebGL storage, not physical VRAM; no Android hardware measurement.
